R1.description: A Codex build's digest covers every file the launch can run as Codex: the launcher's package and each dependency package found where Node's resolution in the launch environment finds it; a layout it cannot bind gives no digest; it is recomputed from disk on every use (#214)

R2.description: The record of verified Codex builds is verified-codex-builds.json in the runtime root with claude_build's schema and trust rules and its own lock, never in the settings file, and verify-claude, its record and its tests are unchanged (#214)

R3.description: is_verified answers from the record and a fresh digest alone, writes nothing, starts no process, says why when it answers no, and has no caller outside tests (#214)

R4.description: The roadmap and the harnesses guide describe the split and what is built; check_docs and the suite are green but for the known tests (#214)
